answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to lock a refundable capital bond before it can trade. Identity then carries a pigment of real stake, not free color. Like a sonnet, each bond follows a fixed form the ledger can verify, and spawning a sybil swarm means climbing a steep ridge of locked capital — one bond per node. Honest agents reclaim theirs; cheats forfeit. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds, so the attack simply does not pay.
